info.title: Management REST API
info.description: Instance HTTP policy applies. Plain HTTP exposes passwords and tokens to the network path. Login is not idempotent: list tokens, revoke an orphan by label/id, then reissue. Tokens cannot mint tokens. Revocation is immediate in this process; a 503 means blocked but not durable across restart. Refusal aggregates can lose up to one minute on crash.
